value.description: Neo-grotesque sans (inferred, an Inter or SF-like face), semibold, sentence case, centred; OCR line box 8.8% of frame height and 77.5% of width when complete. The line recentres on every new word (box centre x 0.505 -> 0.494 -> 0.504). Each word enters pale lilac (#B873B3), turns raspberry (#B73A69) on the next frame, then teal (#0A7F6F), and settles to ink #030303 about 5 frames after it appeared.
Tracked uppercase sans, about 2.5% of frame height, centred under the mark at y 0.56-0.59; typed one letter every 2-3 frames, white on #0D0D15.
Same sans, regular weight, sentence case, OCR box 12.4% of frame height, centred; arrives set on an upward arc and straightens; settles to #884295 purple, then shrinks slightly before the cut.

Mark (rounded square, #030303, about 6% of frame width) plus wordmark in medium sans, cap height similar to the mark's inner glyph; lockup 33% of frame width at 7.83 s, 31% at the end card; centred as a unit.

Real interface type at reading size only after a punch-in: prompt text about 2.8% of frame height before the punch-in and about 7% after (OCR 0.037 -> 0.098 line boxes); checklist rows about 4.5% of frame height, left-aligned at x 0.06-0.08.
Semibold sans, sentence case, about 5.6% line box, centred inside the ring; typed word by word.

Headline: medium sans in #030303, sentence case, about 84% of frame width at y 0.37-0.50, centred. Sub-line: regular sans in #666666, about 64% width directly under it, typed with a visible thin caret. Four pill chips (coloured fill, white label, about 3% of height) float off the corners of the text block.
Dark #333333 pill button with white label, 19% of frame width, 3.3% of height, centred at y 0.64; web address in small grey at y 0.73.

composition.value: Centre-weighted throughout: every hero element (line, mark, lockup, headline, phone, ring) has its centre within 0.45-0.55 of frame width and 0.40-0.55 of height, except the punch-in on the prompt field, which deliberately crops the field off the left edge (field at x 0.0-0.64) so the text reads at 7% of height. The hook line spans 77% of width inside four corner dots placed about 4% outside the text box. The orbit ring is an ellipse about 70% wide by 85% high around a centred line. White space dominates: on white shots the ground is 93-99% of pixels.

palette pixel shares from ffmpeg samples at F0-F880

materials.value: Mostly flat vector on white. Three material accents: a photographic coastal plate with real depth of field (background defocused after the punch-in), a pastel gradient ground with a faint square grid behind the product screen, and a 3D phone with a black bezel lit flat on white. Photo thumbnails in the ring have rounded corners and soft drop shadows.

lighting.value: No staged light on the graphics: shadowless white, soft shadows only under thumbnails and the phone. The plate is late-afternoon natural light. The dark name shot has no gradient or vignette beyond the soft edge of the iris disc.

styleSummary: Clean white product-launch style: one neo-grotesque sans, ink #030303 on #FEFEFE, colour used only as an arrival tint (violet-to-raspberry) and a few accents (teal, a pastel product ground). It feels made rather than generic because something is always being written or carried, and one dark shot and one photographic plate break the white.
